decisions.reason: Having survived its first review and fitting closely into the core modular sensing platform, it likely performs at least near aspiration and is worth retaining as demand evidence accumulates further.
Its strong fit with the firm's established industrial I/O architecture and continued presence after launch suggest results are meeting aspiration well enough to keep it.

As a very recent adjacent module with less visible commitment than core I/O products, it still carries some uncertainty, but the firm's growth, slack and modular strategy favor keeping it for another year rather than cutting it early.

Because remote access supports the firm's stated push into networked charging and energy management, management would likely tolerate short-run uncertainty and keep it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.
